scheme.name: PM Vishwakarma
scheme.ministry: Ministry Of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
scheme.summary: Central Sector Scheme providing recognition, skill training, toolkit incentive, collateral-free credit, digital transaction incentives and marketing support to artisans and craftspeople.
scheme.benefits: Recognition as Vishwakarma through Certificate and ID Card; Skill Verification followed by 5-7 days (40 hours) of Basic Training; 15 days (120 hours) of Advanced Training; Training Stipend: ₹ 500 per day; Toolkit Incentive: ₹ 15,000 grant; Collateral-free Enterprise Development Loans: ₹ 1,00,000 (First Tranche for 18 months repayment) & ₹ 2,00,000 (Second Tranche for 30 months repayment); Concessional Rate of Interest: 5% with Interest Subvention cap of 8% paid by MoMSME; Credit Guarantee fees borne by GoI; Incentive for Digital Transaction: ₹ 1 per transaction for a maximum of up to 100 transactions (monthly); Marketing Support through National Committee for Marketing.

rules.reason: Applicant must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools
Applicant must be engaged in the unorganized sector on a self-employment basis
Applicant must be at least 18 years old on the date of registration
A person in government service and their family members are not eligible

caveats: Applicant should be engaged in one of the 18 family-based traditional trades mentioned in the scheme
Applicant should be engaged in the concerned trade on the date of registration

Applicant should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes of the Central Government or State Government for self-employment/ business development, e.g. PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra, in the past 5 years
Registration and benefits under the Scheme shall be restricted to one member of the family
Family members of a person in government service are not eligible
Verification of Eligibility at Gram Panchayat or ULB level; Vetting and Recommendation by the District Implementation Committee; Final approval by the Screening Committee
scheme.how_to_apply: Apply online via Common Service Centres (CSCs) by enrolling through the nearest CSC, completing biometric verification, and submitting the online application form.

Skilling: Skill Verification followed by 5-7 days (40 hours) of Basic Training
